Population increased in Southampton

The estimated population of Southampton in 2024 was 259,424 usual residents, a rise of 0.8% since 2023.

This meant that Southampton's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Southampton increased by 4.7%.

Over this slightly longer period, Southampton was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Southampton

The average (median) age stayed at 34.3 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Southampton has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Southampton is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Southampton's population of 259,424 usual residents was made up of:

  • 45,324 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17.5%)
  • 178,545 people aged 16 to 64 years, (68.8%)
  • 35,555 people aged 65 years and over, (13.7%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Southampton has a higher proportion of people aged 16 to 64 years (68.8% compared with 62.8% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Southampton, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Southampton
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Southampton, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 567 people (0.2%). In total, there were 2,557 births and 1,990 deaths in Southampton.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 3,050 (-1.2%). There were 18,088 people entering the area and 21,138 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Southampton's population of 4,510 (1.8%) as a result of 11,270 people entering the area and 6,760 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Southampton was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Southampton in mid-2023 is 257,387.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 1,996 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 719 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 1,277 people.
